question: What was the average written premium per vehicle (per written car-year) in 2025?
final_text:
In 2025, average written premium per written car-year was about £753.28.

I took every premium transaction booked in 2025, covering new business, renewals, mid-term adjustments and cancellations. Written premium came to £30,274,839.20. Written car-years (the sum of exposure units) came to 40,190.52, and cancellations reduce that figure. Dividing the first by the second gives £753.28.

I used booked date to decide what counts as 2025. A transaction booked in 2025 with an effective date in another year is still included.

ANSWER: 753.28

input.query: select txn_type, count(*), sum(written_premium), sum(exposure_units), sum(vehicle_delta), min(booked_date), max(booked_date), sum(case when year(booked_date)<>year(effective_date) then 1 else 0 end) diffyr from premium_txn group by 1
select sum(written_premium), sum(exposure_units), sum(written_premium)/sum(exposure_units) from premium_txn where year(booked_date)=2025
